inputs.label: The Maze of the Kings NAOMI ROM sets (MAME mok, naomi)
inputs.help: Your own MAME sets mok.zip and naomi.zip. Leave them zipped.

inputs.label: The Maze of the Kings disc (gds-0022.chd)
inputs.help: The GD-ROM image from the mok folder of your MAME set.

steps.why: The app reads the sets from Download. The guide has the user grant storage access on the first start.

steps.text: Open The Maze of the Kings VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for storage access, allow it.

notes: The guide says "grant storage access" without naming the permission; All files access is assumed. Releases also carry mok-vr-pcvr.zip and mok-vr-source.zip.
